text:
Anita: I've pushed a draft PR that adds a Terraform migration example for Dedicated pools (v1 -> v2 module). Link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4721. Need eyes on attribute names and the migration checklist.
Leo: jumping in. One quick thing: the old module used `reserved_pool_id` and the new API expects `pool_id`. We should show a side-by-side diff in the docs to make this obvious.
Priya: agree. Also the `scale_policy` API field was flattened into `autoscale_policy` in the v2 provider. Add a short note that CLI flags still use "--policy-name" for backwards compatibility.
Anita: good call. I added a small two-column table and a code diff block. Example terraform snippet I added:
```hcl
# v1
module "dedicated_pool" {
  source = "redwood/dedicated/v1"
  reserved_pool_id = "rp-123"
  scale_policy = {
    metric = "queue_length"
  }
}
# v2
module "dedicated_pool" {
  source = "redwood/dedicated/v2"
  pool_id = "rp-123"
  autoscale_policy = {
    metric = "avg_inflight"
  }
}
```
Leo: nit: maybe show the `lifecycle` block suggestion for `prevent_destroy = true` to avoid accidental deletion during migration.
Priya: also add a bullet that quant_profile changes can increase memory usage during migration windows; folks need to watch eviction logs. Link to /docs/optimize/quantization-guide.
Anita: added both. I also included a troubleshooting section: how to roll back if pool fails to attach.
docs-bot: Preview build queued for PR 4721  https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/4721  status: pending
Leo: question on SLA links: the PR references the public SLA page but the internal table lives in infra/wiki. We should point to the canonical public page and add an internal note for on-call.
Priya: can we include a tiny script to validate the TF plan for renames? Something like:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# quick check for rename-driven diffs
terraform plan -out=plan.tfplan
terraform show -json plan.tfplan | jq '.resource_changes[] | select(.change.actions!=[] )' | grep -E "reserved_pool_id|scale_policy" || echo "No rename diffs detected"
```
Anita: love that. I'll add under Migration -> Validation. Also updated TOC to put migration before quickstart.
docs-bot: Preview updated for PR 4721  https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/4721  status: success
Leo: small wording: replace "will be updated" with "must be updated" in the migration checklist to make the action explicit.
Priya: one more: clarify that strict isolation reservations may prevent cross-pool bursting and that autoscale windows should be longer for cold-start models (e.g., 60s).
Anita: done. I also fixed an image path (assets/images/terraform-migration.png) which was 404 in the preview.
eng-runtime: noted the API deprecation timeline. I've added a one-line note with dates and a link to the deprecation RFC.
Anita: thanks everyone. If no other concerns I'll merge after CI. I'll send a short note to #eng-runtime and #product about the TF migration docs.
